一荣俱荣（一荣俱荣（第22页）“嗨？”鼠标完全不在乎道，“道友，你着相了。”也不给在场天骄犹豫的机会，鼠标继续道，“此次参加宿命之战，我穷奇殿连一位荣誉长老都没有指派出，这还不够明显吗？在我穷奇殿看来，宿命之战不全是打打杀杀，能够通过此次宿命之战让穷奇大陆上的很多小辈进一步成长，才是最重要的。”此言入耳，在场的不少天骄也是开始腹诽起来。明面上，穷奇殿是没将长老级强者指派出来，但也得有势力敢针对你们穷奇大陆的这些小辈天骄才可以。怕不是，今日有强者敢将尔等打杀了；来日，穷奇殿便会举全殿之力将对应势力乃至大陆灭了。“算我灵祖大陆一个！”姚嘉庚的这句话虽然简短，却是一颗定心丸。在场的异大陆小辈天骄皆是非常清楚嘉庚茶铺的实力的，那可是……有一位帝君强者分身坐镇的欢乐地。谢长惟一步上前道，“此次城主争夺战算我谢长惟一个。”参加城主争夺战等同自愿加入苍源域，谢长惟也不敢打着瞰灵国谢家的名号参战。而又见付幼鱼等一步跟上，同样是打算以个人身份参战。姚嘉庚的声音再次响起，“好了！都别演了。自今日起，瞰灵国将受我姚老头的庇护，与瞰灵国为敌等同与我姚老头为敌。”在姚嘉庚的帝君身份暴露的那一刻，不说谢长惟等来自灵祖大陆的小辈天骄了，连武书都猜到了姚嘉庚的真实身份。翻开厚土大陆近代史，能够承受帝君一击而不死者，除武书外，再无第二人。此事背后藏着多少水分，或许只有武书的那位便宜外公最清楚。付幼鱼、谢长惟等无不是冲着金光城嘉庚茶铺恭敬道，“前辈的恩情，我等定会铭记于心。”姚嘉庚同样不客气道，“老朽会如此看重尔等，正因尔等的确非常争气。大战在即，望尔等再接再厉。”城主争夺战尚未正式开打，穷奇殿、灵祖大陆已经明确参战，这就让以赵括为首的苍茫大陆等小辈天骄为难了。赵括等不仅全是散修，背后更加没有帝君称号强者兜底。而不论赵括等参不参加这一次的城主争夺战，在赵括等决定获得苍源域身份令牌时，待宿命之战结束，再次回到苍茫大陆，他们会有什么结局便已经是注定好的。“这世态，回不回苍茫大陆，似乎已经不重要了。”当赵括将这些话说出来时，站在其身后的众小辈天骄无不是觉得，那片将自己视为弃子的大陆不回也罢。“此次城主争夺战算我赵括一个。”与鼠标等完全不同的是，在赵括决定参战后，赵括迈出的步伐明显是沉重的。“莫慌！尔等虽是散修，修炼天赋却是远超很多世家及宗门弟子，真到了山穷水尽的地步，不要忘了还有我姚老头。”“姚老头，你够了！”公然抢人，抢的还都是前途无量的小辈天骄，连鼠标都看不下去了。

Yi Rong Ju Rong (Yi Rong Ju Rong (page 22) "Hi?" Mouse said indifferently, "Fellow Taoist, you are in trouble." Without giving the geniuses present a chance to hesitate, Mouse continued, "This time to participate in the fateful battle, I, Qiongqi Palace, did not even appoint an honorary elder. Isn't this obvious enough? In my opinion, the fateful battle is not all about fighting and killing. Through this fateful battle, Qiongqi Continent can be conquered. The most important thing is for the many juniors to grow further. " After hearing this, many geniuses present began to sneer. On the surface, Qiongqi Palace has not assigned elder-level powerful people, but there must be forces that dare to target these junior geniuses in Qiongqi Continent. I am afraid, if there are strong people who dare to kill you today, in the future, Qiongqi Palace will use the power of the entire palace to destroy the corresponding forces and even the mainland. " Count me in the Lingzu Continent!" Although Yao Jiageng's words were brief, they were reassuring. The young geniuses from other continents present were very aware of Jiageng's tea shop. It was a happy place where a powerful clone of the emperor sat. Xie Changwei stepped forward and said, "I, Xie Changwei, am the only one in this battle for the city master." Participating in the battle for the city master is equivalent to voluntarily joining the Cangyuan Territory, and Xie Changwei did not dare to look down on Lingzu. Yao Jiageng's voice sounded again, "Okay! Stop acting. From today on, Guan Lingguo will be affected." The protection of me, Old Man Yao, is the same as being an enemy of me, Old Man Yao." At the moment when Yao Jiageng's identity as emperor was exposed, not to mention Xie Changwei and other junior prodigies from Lingzu Continent, even Wu Shu guessed it. When it comes to Yao Jiageng's true identity, looking at the modern history of Houtu Continent, there is no one other than Wu Shu who can withstand the emperor's blow without dying. Perhaps only Wu Shu is the one behind this matter. The cheap grandfather knew it best. Fu Youyu, Xie Changwei and others all respectfully said to Jiageng Tea Shop in Jinguang City, "Senior's kindness will be remembered in our hearts." Yao Jiageng also said politely, "I will be like this. I value you so much, because you are indeed very ambitious. The battle is about to begin, and I hope you will continue to work hard." The battle for the city master has not officially started yet, and Qiongqi Palace and Lingzu Continent have clearly joined the war, which makes it difficult for the junior geniuses such as Cangmang Continent headed by Zhao Kuo. Zhao Kuo and others are not only casual cultivators, but there is no strong person with the title of emperor behind them. Regardless of whether Zhao Kuo and others will participate in this battle for city master, Zhao Kuo and others When they decided to obtain the Cangyuan Domain Identity Token, it was already determined what their fate would be when they returned to the Vast Continent. "In this world, whether or not we can return to the Vast Continent doesn't seem to matter anymore." When Zhao Kuo said these words, all the junior geniuses standing behind him felt that it would be fine if I didn't return to the continent that regarded them as abandoned children. "Completely different from Mouse and others, Zhao Kuo took a heavy step after he decided to join the war. "Don't panic! Although you are casual cultivators, your cultivation talent is far beyond that of many disciples of the family and sect. If you are really at the end of your rope, don't forget about me, Old Man Yao!" He openly robbed people, and even Mouse was robbed.
